Sofia, I replied in the thread on your message in #coastal-team.

The channel shows two numbers. On 17 Nov 2025 Bettina posted 12%, then about a minute later corrected it to 10%. She said she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. So 10% is the later figure, but nothing in the channel confirms it as the settled term.

I can't see the signed order form or the deal-desk record, so please confirm with June Osei-Lark before the renewal brief goes out.
